Not connected

Disconnected by Android
Another VPN app was turned on or the permission was removed. Your apps no longer go through your proxy.
Choose a proxy for Always-on VPN

Android started ProxyFlow as your Always-on VPN, but no proxy is chosen, so ProxyFlow didn\'t connect. Open ProxyFlow and choose one. With \u201cBlock connections without VPN\u201d on, apps have no internet until then.
